prompt:
# Debugging evidence trail

CRITICAL VISUAL RULE: explain the debugging flow entirely through branch density, filtering, checkpoints, and restrained color. Keep every surface blank. Do not draw the GitHub logo, Mona, Octocat, Invertocat, the Copilot mascot, wordmarks, letters, numbers, code, charts, interface controls, badges, captions, or labeled icons.

Create premium animated 16:9 GitHub key art, composed safely inside a 3:2 generation canvas. Render a bright editorial 2.5D scene on a white and warm off-white background with subtle contribution-grid texture, repository branch traces, crisp Octicon-inspired geometry, soft neutral shadows, and restrained depth. Use approximately 80% white or off-white, 10% neutral gray, 5% GitHub green, and 5% Copilot purple, with one very small amber failure accent.

Show five differently shaped evidence streams as tangled branch traces that progressively simplify through a physical funnel into one small verified cause marked only by a green focus ring. The visual metaphor must immediately communicate calm, methodical debugging: shrink the graph, inspect evidence, and isolate one cause before changing architecture.

Keep the upper-left 42% calm for the exact native slide title. Leave a clean foreground position beside the evidence funnel where approved, unmodified mascot artwork can be layered later in Slidev. No people, mascots, logos, generic analytics dashboards, words, letters, fake product UI, screenshots, interface panels, dark panels, or watermarks.
